description: Untrusted bytes are passed to pickle.loads, which can execute arbitrary code during deserialization. A single recognizable dangerous call, now caught by the detector's pickle rule.

provenance.owasp_2021: A08:2021 - Software and Data Integrity Failures
provenance.selection_rationale: Rank 16 in the 2024 CWE Top 25 and the canonical insecure-deserialization flaw; pickle.loads is the standard Python instance, realizable with only the standard library and semantic rather than pattern-visible.
